findings.reason: Deletion test: 'And the mage's marks sat on that same web of roads in clumps. All of them, every heavy one and every old one, sat on the south road...' survives and is more direct; the following sentence already rules the King's road out. Fix is deletion of the cited sentence.

findings.text: No *are you sure you don't want me to check it again*, not one glance up to see whether it had been good enough.

Deletion test survives. Fix is deletion; the paragraph then opens 'A Kirin Tor mage, and Sylvanas had yet to meet one...'.

findings.text: Her palm was bare, and the wood was not smooth under it.
findings.pattern: Pattern 4 minimizer (negated descriptor before the real one)
findings.reason: Names the texture by refusing 'smooth' before the next sentence supplies the real surface. State the texture positively.
findings.suggestedFix: Her palm was bare, and the wood under it was ridged.
findings.deletionTest: Her palm was bare. The bench was made of wagon boards.

Atmospheric 'The night came in' (L575) and 'the cold came in with her' (L83) are ambient inversions owned by pass B; logged, not judged here.
